title: The effect of intensive treatment of diabetes on the development and progression of long-term complications in insulin-dependent diabetes mellitus
addedReason: DCCT — the landmark trial proving that intensive insulin therapy reduces retinopathy, nephropathy, and neuropathy in Type 1 diabetes; primary source for all DCCT citations in compound.json including hypoglycemia risk data and efficacy findings.

title: Intensive blood-glucose control with sulphonylureas or insulin compared with conventional treatment and risk of complications in patients with type 2 diabetes (UKPDS 33)
addedReason: UKPDS 33 — defining trial of intensive glycaemic control in Type 2 diabetes; primary source for UKPDS citations including microvascular benefit data, weight gain evidence, and the legacy effect via the 10-year post-trial follow-up (PMID 18784090).

title: Basal insulin and cardiovascular and other outcomes in dysglycemia (ORIGIN Trial)
addedReason: ORIGIN Trial — largest trial of early basal insulin in dysglycemia; primary source for ORIGIN citations including cardiovascular neutrality, hypoglycemia rates, and weight gain data for glargine vs. standard care.

title: Effects of intensive glucose lowering in type 2 diabetes (ACCORD Trial)
addedReason: ACCORD — pivotal trial stopped early due to increased mortality in intensive glycaemic control arm; primary source for all ACCORD citations including mortality data (HR 1.22), severe hypoglycemia rates, and the shift toward individualised glycaemic targets.

title: The Insulin Receptor and Its Signal Transduction Network
addedReason: Endotext/NCBI Bookshelf chapter on insulin receptor signalling; primary source for mechanism of action content including PI3K/Akt pathway, GLUT4 translocation, mTOR anabolic effects, and insulin resistance mechanisms.

title: Growth hormone, IGF-I and insulin and their abuse in sport
addedReason: Review of insulin misuse in athletics; primary source for the athlete/performance context including anabolic rationale, IOC/WADA ban history, detection challenges, and health risks of non-medical insulin use.

title: Hypoglycemia in diabetes: An update on pathophysiology, treatment, and prevention
addedReason: Comprehensive review of hypoglycemia pathophysiology, ADA classification levels, HAAF mechanisms, cardiovascular consequences, and treatment protocols; primary source for the hypoglycemia side effect section.

title: Lipodystrophy in Insulin-Treated Subjects and Other Injection-Site Skin Reactions: Are We Sure Everything is Clear?
addedReason: Clinical review of lipodystrophy including prevalence (46% of insulin users have LH), mechanisms of lipoatrophy vs. lipohypertrophy, glycaemic consequences of injection site complications, and prevention strategies.

title: Mechanisms linking obesity to insulin resistance and type 2 diabetes
addedReason: Nature review by Kahn, Hull, Utzschneider on mechanisms linking obesity to insulin resistance; primary source for insulin resistance mechanism section including adipose dysfunction, inflammation, FFA lipotoxicity, and beta-cell failure.

title: Insulin-associated weight gain in diabetes — causes, effects and coping strategies
addedReason: Dedicated review of insulin-associated weight gain mechanisms (reduced glycosuria, adipogenesis, defensive eating, unphysiological pharmacokinetics); primary source for weight gain section and insulin/fat myth content.

title: Weightlifting's risky new trend: a case series of 41 insulin users
addedReason: Most systematic published study of insulin misuse in non-diabetic strength athletes; primary source for prevalence data (56.8% hypoglycemia rate), demographic profile, acquisition patterns, and polydrug use context.

title: Insulin Myths and Facts
addedReason: ADA Clinical Diabetes article cataloguing common insulin myths with evidence-based realities; primary source for all mythsVsReality entries including addiction, treatment failure framing, complication causation, and dietary replacement claims.

title: ADA Standards of Care in Diabetes — 2025, Section 9: Pharmacologic Approaches to Glycemic Treatment
addedReason: ADA 2025 guidelines on pharmacological insulin therapy including insulin types, basal-bolus protocols, Type 1 and Type 2 recommendations, CGM integration, and weight management context; primary source for dosageAndProtocols section.

title: ADA Standards of Care in Diabetes — 2025, Section 6: Glycemic Goals and Hypoglycemia
addedReason: ADA 2025 glycaemic target guidelines including HbA1c targets (<7% for most adults), fasting glucose targets (80-130 mg/dL), CGM Time in Range targets (≥70% time 70-180 mg/dL), and kidney/lipid monitoring guidance; primary source for bloodworkMonitoring section.

title: Lantus (insulin glargine injection) — FDA Prescribing Information
addedReason: Official FDA-approved prescribing information for insulin glargine (Lantus); reference for indications, mechanism of action, dosing regimens, contraindications, adverse reactions (hypoglycemia, weight gain, lipodystrophy), and drug interactions.

title: The Diabetes Control and Complications Trial/Epidemiology of Diabetes Interventions and Complications Study at 30 Years: Overview
addedReason: 30-year overview of DCCT/EDIC including metabolic memory phenomenon, the 58% cardiovascular event reduction after 18 years, long-term kidney and neuropathy outcomes, and the finding that HbA1c explained >98% of complication differences; primary source for evidenceLandscape and long-term timeline section.
